title: A prompt revision needs a stable evaluation target
method: Synthetic 80-message triage set with fixed labels and model settings. Rates are 64/80 = 80% and 70/80 = 87.5%. Urgency errors and human review effort are separate outcomes and must also be inspected.
alt: A prompt revision needs a stable evaluation target. Version A: 64 correct categories out of 80, Version B: 70 correct categories out of 80. Illustrative data.
